answer: Require each identity to stake a bond anchored to a single verified device and pass unpredictable live checks: each check asks for a fresh task tied to that identity's own past work, so answers cannot be copied across accounts. A real agent passes once and keeps a crystal-clear record, while a Sybil operator must fund a separate bond and staff a separate live responder for every fake, as if watching a separate sparrow for each nest. Missed or copied checks slash the bond and prune the identity before it can earn or vote, so fakes cost more than they gain.
